D: The misfit Delta fraternity takes on the dean of Faber College.
P: Serve the mains when Bluto yells food fight.
S: Bluto's mash and gravy cafeteria cups
Bluto loading his tray in the cafeteria

Little cups of buttery mashed potato under rich brown onion gravy, topped with crispy fried shallots and chives, served on a cafeteria tray. Boil 1kg peeled floury potatoes for 20 minutes, drain and mash with 80g butter, 100ml warm milk and salt. Soften a sliced onion in 20g butter for 10 minutes, stir in 1 tbsp flour, then 400ml beef stock and simmer 5 minutes until glossy. Spoon the mash into 8 small cups, pour over the gravy and top with fried shallots and chopped chives.
Frozen grapes, olives, feta in oil and warm pita wedges
Grapes frozen for 2 hours, piled on a big platter with olives, feta and pita, so everyone can eat like Romans.
Baked crisp chicken wings tossed in honey barbecue sauce
Wings dried overnight, baked at 220C for 45 minutes until crisp, tossed in a barbecue and honey glaze.
M: Beef, onion and green pepper in tangy tomato sauce on toasted buns
Beef mince browned with onion and capsicum, tomato sauce, Worcestershire, brown sugar and mustard, simmered 20 minutes until thick, piled onto toasted soft buns.

Franks griddled until blistered in steamed buns, piled with buttery slow-cooked onions, warm caraway sauerkraut and yellow mustard. Cook 2 sliced onions in 40g butter over low heat for 20 minutes until soft and golden. Warm 400g sauerkraut with 1 tsp caraway seeds for 5 minutes. Simmer 8 franks for 5 minutes, then griddle until blistered. Steam 8 hot dog buns in a covered colander over boiling water for 1 minute. Fill with franks, onions and sauerkraut and finish with yellow mustard.
W: Vanilla cupcakes with brightly colored swirled buttercream
Vanilla cupcakes baked at 175C for 18 minutes, topped with buttercream in bright colours, safe to throw. Please don't.
K: Pineapple, orange and lemonade punch, with vodka in the adults' bowl only
Fruit punch of pineapple and orange juice, lemonade and vodka for the adults, in a big bowl with sliced fruit.

note.text: Nothing is over until we say it is. Now grab a toga and follow me.

steps.text: Freeze the grapes.
Warm the pita and cut into wedges.
Pile the grapes on a big platter with the olives and feta drizzled with oil, and the pita. Eat lying down like a Roman.
Pat the wings dry and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight.
Toss with garlic powder and salt.
Bake at 220C until crisp.
Warm the barbecue sauce with the honey and toss the wings through.
Dice the onion and capsicum.
Brown the mince with the onion and capsicum.
Add the tomato sauce, Worcestershire sauce, sugar and mustard and simmer until thick.
Toast the buns and pile the mince on.
Beat 125g of the butter with the sugar, add the eggs and fold in the flour and milk.
Spoon into 12 cupcake cases and bake at 175C.
Cool the cupcakes.
Beat the remaining butter with the icing sugar, tint bright colours and swirl on.
Slice the orange.
Pour the juices into a big bowl with ice and sliced orange. Top with lemonade.
Add the vodka to the adults' bowl only.
Slice the orange and lime.
Pour the juices into a big bowl with ice and the sliced fruit.
Top with lemonade and ginger beer for a bit of bite.

s.note: Frozen grapes, olives, feta in oil and warm pita wedges
s.how: Freeze 500g grapes for 2 hours. Pile on a big platter with 200g olives, 200g feta drizzled with oil and 4 warm pita breads cut into wedges. Eat lying down like a Roman.

s.note: Baked crisp chicken wings tossed in honey barbecue sauce
s.how: Dry 1kg chicken wings overnight and toss with garlic powder and salt. Bake at 220C for 45 minutes until crisp. Toss in 100ml barbecue sauce warmed with 2 tbsp honey.

m.note: Beef, onion and green pepper in tangy tomato sauce on toasted buns
m.how: Brown 800g beef mince with an onion and a green capsicum. Add 200ml tomato sauce, 2 tbsp Worcestershire, 1 tbsp brown sugar and 1 tbsp mustard and simmer 20 minutes until thick. Pile onto 4 toasted soft buns.

w.note: Vanilla cupcakes with brightly colored swirled buttercream
w.how: Beat 125g butter with 150g sugar, add 2 eggs and fold in 200g self-raising flour and 125ml milk. Bake 12 at 175C for 18 minutes. Beat 150g butter with 300g icing sugar, tint bright colours and swirl on.

d.note: Pineapple, orange and lemonade punch, with vodka in the adults' bowl only
d.how: Pour 500ml pineapple juice and 500ml orange juice into a big bowl with ice and sliced oranges. Top with 750ml lemonade. Add 150ml vodka for the adults' bowl only.
